title: IngestionManifest
description: I1 manifest-driven bulk ingestion declaration (version 1). The manifest declares WHAT should be ingested for one corpus: corpus identity, defaults, and a list of document sources resolved relative to the manifest file. It is an ingestion DECLARATION, not destructive desired-state reconciliation: documents absent from a later manifest are never deleted. The control plane decides what remains to be done; workers perform the existing pipeline. Unknown fields fail validation (closed schema). Source paths must be unique per manifest (duplicates fail validation).

corpus_id.description: Declared corpus identity carried through the existing lifecycle. Never derived from folder names when the manifest provides it explicitly.

source.description: Path relative to the manifest file location (never process cwd).
